purpose: Gate debugging of malformed JSON before returning to cache-reuse research, not a contribution or mechanism test.
sampling: Eight fixed researcher-written encoding fixtures, four action kinds times minimal/context variants; two presentation arms, one call each, sixteen calls total.
contrast: Original comma-separated examples versus labeled separated alternatives plus explicit one-object instructions. This is a presentation bundle, not identification of a comma-only cause.
order: Fixed SHA-256 case order, alternating which arm comes first across eight pairs; four pairs each order. No retries or additional repetitions based on outcomes.
primary: For all planned slots, report normal-finish AND strict action-schema admission. Separate unobserved or infrastructure-failed slots; never impute them as malformed outputs.
secondary: exact intended action and argument encoding
reported token use and conservative client costs
failure_policy: Malformed model content is retained and scored without repair, and the fixed sequence continues. Transport, model alias, token count, timing, budget or journal failures stop the batch. No completed-prefix arm contrast after infrastructure stop.
no_inference: No general reliability guarantee from 16 calls
No post-hoc salvage of old responses

next_gate.any_infrastructure_failure: Audit incomplete records; do not draw paired effects or automatically rerun.
next_gate.separated_arm_any_invalid: Do not expand research runs with this candidate; retain calibration and reassess interface options before requesting further paid work.
next_gate.separated_all_admitted_but_wrong_encodin: Formatting alone is insufficient; inspect exact-encoding failures without labeling them cache-induced drift.
next_gate.separated_all_exact_original_has_invalid: Candidate for a separately approved research-context interface check, not proof of root cause or readiness for large-scale inference.
next_gate.both_all_exact: Simple fixtures did not reproduce failure; do not declare the prior problem fixed. A small research-context check would still be required before expansion.
